title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
title_zh: SCOPE：将自然语言策略编译为神经符号谓词程序

paragraphs.en: Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. The program is optimized jointly with its training data, using adversarial generation of counterexamples that target where the program deviates from the policy. We evaluate SCOPE on a benchmark of real-world policy tasks against prompt optimization, task decomposition, and workflow generation methods, achieving the highest average accuracy across tasks and models. Programs optimized with the weakest executor transfer to other models without further optimization. This allows them to be deployed in production on inexpensive models, where they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models. Unlike these monolithic models, SCOPE produces substantially more stable predictions, and each verdict is interpretable through the predicate outputs that produced it. Additionally, we validate the key components of our method through an ablation study. SCOPE thus enables reliable, interpretable, and efficient policy enforcement at production scale.

paragraphs.en: Large language models are increasingly deployed to enforce the policies of the organizations that run them, from content rules [ 37 , 31 , 98 ] and regulatory obligations [ 17 ] to application-specific constraints on permissible system behavior [ 89 , 54 ] . As these applications advance from single-turn moderation to multi-turn assistants and tool-using agents, both the policies and the inputs they govern grow more complex. The unit of judgment becomes a long transcript [ 33 , 94 ] , a structured plan [ 35 ] , or an agent trajectory [ 89 , 12 ] rather than a single message, and a modern policy is rarely one flat category: it bundles conditions, exceptions, counts, and interactions that must be assessed together [ 33 ] . Adhering to such a policy is therefore both critical and hard [ 94 ] , as the verdict turns on a compound, context-dependent specification rather than a single surface feature, where one overlooked clause produces a false violation or a missed obligation.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型正日益被部署用于执行运营方组织的政策，从内容规则 [ 37 , 31 , 98 ] 和监管义务 [ 17 ] ，到针对允许的系统行为的应用特定约束 [ 89 , 54 ] 。 随着这些应用从单轮审核发展到多轮助手和使用工具的智能体，政策及其所治理的输入都变得更加复杂。 判断的对象不再是单条消息，而是长对话记录 [ 33 , 94 ] 、结构化计划 [ 35 ] 或智能体轨迹 [ 89 , 12 ] ，而且现代政策很少是单一的扁平类别：它捆绑了必须共同评估的条件、例外、计数和交互 [ 33 ] 。 因此，遵守这样的政策既至关重要又十分困难 [ 94 ] ，因为结论取决于一个复合的、依赖上下文的规范而非单一表面特征，其中任何被忽略的条款都会导致错误的违规判定或遗漏应尽的义务。

paragraphs.en: The most direct approach uses a language model as the policy classifier itself. Its principal advantage is generality: any policy that can be expressed in natural language can be enforced without a predefined taxonomy [ 33 , 67 , 62 ] . This approach takes two forms. The first trains a custom classifier on the task, typically a small fine-tuned guardrail model [ 37 , 31 , 98 , 24 ] . Such models are fast and inexpensive, and on a single, well-scoped rule they match far larger models [ 54 ] . Their capacity is the ceiling, so accuracy falls as a policy compounds interacting conditions beyond what one model resolves in a single pass [ 20 ] . The second prompts a frontier model with the policy at runtime and reads its verdict, the paradigm known as LLM-as-a-judge [ 101 , 50 ] . While it is more capable on the compound case, its predictions are unstable [ 30 , 76 , 7 ] , with variance rising with the number of clauses in the input [ 57 ] . Further, even dedicated reasoning models collapse past a complexity threshold rather than scaling through it [ 79 ] . Finally, its inference cost and latency make it impractical at production scale, where high-throughput classification is required. The first form is thus reliable only on simple policies, while the second is neither stable nor scalable.
paragraphs.zh: 最直接的方法是让语言模型本身充当策略分类器。 它的主要优势在于通用性：任何能够用自然语言表达的策略都无需预先定义的分类体系即可被强制执行 [ 33 , 67 , 62 ] 。 这种方法有两种形式。 第一种是在该任务上训练一个自定义分类器，通常是一个经过微调的小型护栏模型 [ 37 , 31 , 98 , 24 ] 。 这类模型速度快、成本低，并且在单一、界定清晰的规则上可以媲美规模大得多的模型 [ 54 ] 。 它们的容量就是上限，因此当策略包含的相互作用的条件超出单一模型单次处理所能解决的范围时，准确率就会下降 [ 20 ] 。 第二种是在运行时将策略输入提示词以驱动一个前沿模型并读取其判定结果，这就是所谓的 LLM-as-a-judge（大模型即裁判）范式 [ 101 , 50 ] 。 虽然它在复合情形上能力更强，但其预测并不稳定 [ 30 , 76 , 7 ] ，方差会随输入中条款数量的增加而上升 [ 57 ] 。 此外，即使是专门的推理模型，一旦超过某个复杂度阈值也会失效，而不是随复杂度扩展而持续有效 [ 79 ] 。 最后，其推理成本和延迟使其在生产规模上不切实际，因为生产环境需要高吞吐量的分类。 因此，第一种形式仅在简单策略上可靠，而第二种形式既不稳定也不可扩展。

paragraphs.en: A neurosymbolic approach is the natural alternative. Such methods pair neural components that supply semantic judgment with a symbolic layer that composes their outputs under explicit logic [ 52 , 49 ] . Because each sub-decision is narrowly scoped and the composition is explicit, the verdict is more stable than a monolithic judgment [ 46 ] . As narrow sub-decisions are simpler [ 41 , 102 , 70 ] , they can also be answered by small models, which makes the system cheaper to run. The weakness of existing methods lies in the symbolic layer itself, along two axes. The first is expressiveness: checklists [ 46 , 15 ] , weighted rule sets [ 92 , 58 ] , and compiled Boolean or probabilistic rules [ 12 , 38 , 93 ] cannot express the conditional, iterative, and computational structure that complex real-world use cases carry. The second is bias: a learned or synthesized layer is fit to a proxy for the policy, not to the policy itself, whether a rule set tuned to its training samples [ 92 ] , a program searched against a static benchmark [ 99 , 34 ] , or a function verified against self-generated tests and specifications [ 56 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 神经符号方法是自然而然的替代方案。 这类方法将提供语义判断的神经组件与在显式逻辑下组合其输出的符号层相结合 [ 52 , 49 ] 。 由于每个子决策的范围都很狭窄，且组合过程是显式的，因此相比于单一整体式判断，其裁决更为稳定 [ 46 ] 。 由于狭窄的子决策更为简单 [ 41 , 102 , 70 ] ，它们也可以由小模型来回答，从而使系统运行成本更低。 现有方法的弱点恰恰在于符号层本身，体现在两个方面。 第一个是表达能力：清单 [ 46 , 15 ] 、加权规则集 [ 92 , 58 ] 以及编译后的布尔规则或概率规则 [ 12 , 38 , 93 ] 无法表达复杂现实用例所携带的条件、迭代和计算结构。 第二个是偏差：学习得到的或合成的层拟合的是策略的代理，而非策略本身，无论是针对其训练样本调优的规则集 [ 92 ] 、针对静态基准搜索得到的程序 [ 99 , 34 ] ，还是针对自生成测试和规范验证的函数 [ 56 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce SCOPE (Symbolic Composition Over Predicates and Extractors), which compiles a natural-language policy into a neurosymbolic program: neural predicates resolved by weak models, cheap sub-frontier models served without extended reasoning, deterministic extractors for exact computation, and executable code that composes their outputs. Expressiveness is met by the composition being code: it expresses the structure of real-world policies naturally, which rule-based formalisms capture only at low fidelity. Bias is mitigated by how the training data is built. Rather than relying only on a static training set, the search draws on an adversary that repeatedly generates counterexamples targeting where the current program departs from the specification [ 80 ] , and the program is revised against them. Counterexamples are produced by the adversary at two levels: local drift, where a predicate no longer tracks the clause it transcribes, and global drift, where the decomposition as a whole misses a predicate or misroutes an interaction between clauses. Each counterexample is labeled by a strong teacher applying the full policy, and the cost is paid once at compilation. The unit of optimization is thus not a single rule [ 54 ] but the compound policy: each round adds counterexamples and updates both the predicate formulations and the code that composes them. The converged program runs entirely on weak models, so it is cheap to serve. Each verdict is attributable to the predicate outputs behind it rather than a post-hoc rationale, and, being built from narrow classifications, is more stable than a monolithic judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出SCOPE（Symbolic Composition Over Predicates and Extractors），它将自然语言策略编译为一个神经符号程序：由弱模型解析的神经谓词、无需扩展推理即可服务的廉价次前沿模型、用于精确计算的确定性抽取器，以及组合这些输出的可执行代码。 表达力来自组合以代码实现：它自然地表达真实世界策略的结构，而基于规则的形式化方法只能低保真度地捕捉这一点。 偏差通过训练数据的构建方式得到缓解。 搜索并非仅依赖静态训练集，而是借助一个对抗方反复生成针对当前程序偏离规范之处[80]的反例，并据此对程序进行修订。 反例由对抗方在两个层面产生：局部漂移，即某个谓词不再追踪它所转写的条款；全局漂移，即分解整体遗漏了某个谓词或错误路由了条款之间的交互。 每个反例由应用完整策略的强教师模型标注，其成本只在编译时支付一次。 因此优化的单元不是单条规则[54]，而是复合策略：每一轮都会加入反例，并同时更新谓词表述以及组合它们的代码。 收敛后的程序完全在弱模型上运行，因此服务成本低廉。 每个判定都可归因于其背后的谓词输出，而非事后生成的理由，并且由于由狭义分类构建而成，比整体式判断更加稳定。

sents.en: In this paper, we introduce SCOPE (Symbolic Composition Over Predicates and Extractors), which compiles a natural-language policy into a neurosymbolic program: neural predicates resolved by weak models, cheap sub-frontier models served without extended reasoning, deterministic extractors for exact computation, and executable code that composes their outputs.
sents.zh: 本文提出SCOPE（Symbolic Composition Over Predicates and Extractors），它将自然语言策略编译为一个神经符号程序：由弱模型解析的神经谓词、无需扩展推理即可服务的廉价次前沿模型、用于精确计算的确定性抽取器，以及组合这些输出的可执行代码。

sents.en: Expressiveness is met by the composition being code: it expresses the structure of real-world policies naturally, which rule-based formalisms capture only at low fidelity.
sents.zh: 表达力来自组合以代码实现：它自然地表达真实世界策略的结构，而基于规则的形式化方法只能低保真度地捕捉这一点。

sents.en: Bias is mitigated by how the training data is built.
sents.zh: 偏差通过训练数据的构建方式得到缓解。

sents.en: Rather than relying only on a static training set, the search draws on an adversary that repeatedly generates counterexamples targeting where the current program departs from the specification [ 80 ] , and the program is revised against them.
sents.zh: 搜索并非仅依赖静态训练集，而是借助一个对抗方反复生成针对当前程序偏离规范之处[80]的反例，并据此对程序进行修订。

sents.en: Counterexamples are produced by the adversary at two levels: local drift, where a predicate no longer tracks the clause it transcribes, and global drift, where the decomposition as a whole misses a predicate or misroutes an interaction between clauses.
sents.zh: 反例由对抗方在两个层面产生：局部漂移，即某个谓词不再追踪它所转写的条款；全局漂移，即分解整体遗漏了某个谓词或错误路由了条款之间的交互。

sents.en: Each counterexample is labeled by a strong teacher applying the full policy, and the cost is paid once at compilation.
sents.zh: 每个反例由应用完整策略的强教师模型标注，其成本只在编译时支付一次。

sents.en: The unit of optimization is thus not a single rule [ 54 ] but the compound policy: each round adds counterexamples and updates both the predicate formulations and the code that composes them.
sents.zh: 因此优化的单元不是单条规则[54]，而是复合策略：每一轮都会加入反例，并同时更新谓词表述以及组合它们的代码。

sents.en: The converged program runs entirely on weak models, so it is cheap to serve.
sents.zh: 收敛后的程序完全在弱模型上运行，因此服务成本低廉。

sents.en: Each verdict is attributable to the predicate outputs behind it rather than a post-hoc rationale, and, being built from narrow classifications, is more stable than a monolithic judgment.
sents.zh: 每个判定都可归因于其背后的谓词输出，而非事后生成的理由，并且由于由狭义分类构建而成，比整体式判断更加稳定。

paragraphs.en: We release a benchmark of four policy-enforcement tasks, derived from public benchmarks or modeled on deployed agentic systems. The tasks span long agent traces, multi-turn counting, critic auditing, and dynamic multi-label outputs. SCOPE attains the best accuracy in most task-executor settings, outperforming prompt optimization, neurosymbolic methods, and workflow generation. Its advantage grows as the executor weakens. Once a policy is compiled into predicates a weak model can answer without reasoning, accuracy becomes largely insensitive to the choice of executor. Programs compiled with our weakest executor transfer directly to other models, matching frontier reasoning models at a fraction of the inference cost. They are also far more stable: where reasoning models flip a substantial share of their verdicts across repeated runs, SCOPE’s predictions remain nearly fixed, and each verdict traces to the predicate outputs that produced it. Ablations confirm that adversarial generation is central to these gains. More broadly, SCOPE shows that natural-language policies can be compiled rather than interpreted, turning policy enforcement from an opaque judgment delegated to a frontier model into a program that can be optimized, inspected, and deployed at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了一个包含四个策略执行任务的基准，这些任务源自公开基准或以已部署的智能体系统为原型建模。 这些任务涵盖长智能体轨迹、多轮计数、评审者审计以及动态多标签输出。 SCOPE 在大多数任务-执行器设置中取得了最佳准确率，优于提示优化、神经符号方法和工作流生成。 其优势随着执行器变弱而增大。 一旦策略被编译为谓词，弱模型无需推理即可作答，准确率在很大程度上不再受执行器选择的影响。 用我们最弱的执行器编译出的程序可直接迁移到其他模型，以极小的推理成本达到与前沿推理模型相当的表现。 它们还稳定得多：推理模型在多次重复运行中会翻转相当比例的判定，而 SCOPE 的预测几乎保持不变，且每个判定都可追溯至产生它的谓词输出。 消融实验证实，对抗性生成是这些增益的关键。 更广泛地说，SCOPE 表明自然语言策略可以被编译而非被解释，从而将策略执行从委托给前沿模型的不透明判断，转变为可优化、可审查、可大规模部署的程序。

paragraphs.en: Policy enforcement asks a classifier to decide whether an input satisfies a policy written in prose. Modern deployments impose requirements that earlier content moderation did not. Policies may involve complex combinations of conditions, exceptions, counts, and interactions that must be assessed together, potentially over long inputs such as multi-turn transcripts [ 33 , 94 ] , structured plans [ 35 ] , or agent trajectories [ 89 , 12 ] , in which the evidence deciding the verdict occupies a small fraction of the context. On such a policy the verdict must nonetheless be accurate, since one overlooked clause yields a false violation or a missed obligation. It must also be cheap, because the enforcer gates every interaction and its cost is paid on each one [ 54 , 100 ] , and consistent, because a verdict that shifts with position or surface form is not an enforcement of the policy at all [ 86 , 21 , 96 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 策略执行要求分类器判断某个输入是否满足一条以自然语言表述的策略。 现代部署提出了早期内容审核所不曾有的要求。 策略可能涉及复杂的条件、例外、计数和交互的组合，必须将其作为整体进行评估，且评估对象可能是长输入，例如多轮对话记录 [ 33 , 94 ]、结构化计划 [ 35 ] 或智能体轨迹 [ 89 , 12 ]，其中决定结论的证据只占上下文的一小部分。 在这样的策略下，结论仍必须准确，因为忽略任何一个条款都会导致误判违规或漏判义务。 它还必须足够廉价，因为执行器会对每次交互进行把关，其成本在每次交互时都要支付 [ 54 , 100 ]；同时必须保持一致，因为随位置或表面形式而变化的结论根本算不上是对策略的执行 [ 86 , 21 , 96 ]。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches trade expressiveness against cost and consistency. Blocklists and regular expressions are the least expressive: deterministic, perfectly repeatable, and nearly free to run, but blind to anything their patterns do not literally contain [ 82 , 60 ] . Compact models fine-tuned on a single narrow task judge semantics rather than surface form [ 37 , 31 , 98 , 24 , 51 ] , and need no annotation once their training data is synthesized from the policy text alone [ 54 , 78 , 16 ] ; their capacity is the ceiling, and accuracy falls once a policy bundles interacting conditions that a single forward pass must resolve together [ 20 , 57 ] . Guardrails conditioned on a policy supplied at runtime [ 33 , 66 , 19 , 43 ] are expressive and cheap, but, being far smaller than frontier models, they share the capacity ceiling above and still err on multi-clause policies [ 33 ] . Frontier LLM-as-a-judge [ 101 , 50 ] is the most expressive and is accurate on compound policies. Yet it is the least consistent [ 30 , 76 ] , variance rising with the number of clauses [ 57 ] , and the most expensive, a frontier call for every gated interaction. Prompt optimization [ 103 , 71 , 91 , 88 , 40 , 65 , 97 , 13 , 1 , 47 ] can tune the judge’s instructions, but as the verdict of a monolithic judge still comes from a single call, it inherits the same limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法在表达能力、成本与一致性之间进行权衡。 黑名单和正则表达式的表达能力最弱：它们是确定性的、完全可复现的、运行成本几乎为零，但对其模式未明确涵盖的任何内容一无所知 [ 82 , 60 ] 。 在单一狭窄任务上微调的紧凑模型判断的是语义而非表面形式 [ 37 , 31 , 98 , 24 , 51 ] ，且一旦其训练数据仅从策略文本合成，就无需人工标注 [ 54 , 78 , 16 ] ；但其模型容量是上限，一旦策略捆绑了单个前向传播必须一并解析的相互作用的条件，准确率就会下降 [ 20 , 57 ] 。 以运行时提供的策略为条件的护栏 [ 33 , 66 , 19 , 43 ] 表达能力强且成本低，但由于远小于前沿模型，它们同样受上述容量上限的制约，并且在多子句策略上仍会出错 [ 33 ] 。 前沿 LLM 作为裁判 [ 101 , 50 ] 表达能力最强，并且在复合策略上是准确的。 然而它的稳定性最差 [ 30 , 76 ] ，方差随子句数量的增加而上升 [ 57 ] ，且成本最高——每一次受控交互都需要一次前沿模型调用。 提示词优化 [ 103 , 71 , 91 , 88 , 40 , 65 , 97 , 13 , 1 , 47 ] 可以调整裁判的指令，但由于单体裁判的判定仍来自单次调用，它继承了同样的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Scope breaks this trade-off. A policy is compiled into a program whose atoms are predicates resolved by small models and whose composition is explicit code, so the expressiveness of a frontier judge is obtained at the cost and the repeatability of a weak classifier: no strong-model call is made at inference, the composition is deterministic, and both the predicates and the code composing them are optimized against the policy itself.
paragraphs.zh: 作用域打破了这种权衡。 策略被编译成一个程序，其原子是由小模型解析的谓词，其组合是显式代码，因此以弱分类器的成本和可重复性获得了前沿裁判的表达能力：推理时不调用强模型，组合是确定性的，并且谓词以及组合它们的代码都是针对策略本身进行优化的。

paragraphs.en: Neurosymbolic methods pair neural components, which supply semantic judgment, with a symbolic layer that composes their outputs. Keeping the composition explicit rather than folding it into a network’s weights makes the verdict readable and checkable, and captures procedural structure that a single forward pass does not [ 10 ] . Two axes organize what follows: how expressive the symbolic layer is, and how much of the method is learned rather than fixed in advance. On the first axis, the layer ranges from a logic program [ 52 , 49 ] to executable code [ 22 , 11 , 48 , 29 , 84 , 83 , 14 ] , which, unlike a logic program whose rules are written by hand and whose neural predicates are trained through its inference, can be written and revised by an LLM and can call models directly on intermediate results. On the second axis, both the composition and the neural predicates it calls may be either given or learned. Classical differentiable programs fix the structure and train the predicates through it [ 52 , 49 , 4 ] , while others search for the structure as well: over a typed functional language [ 85 ] , guided by neural relaxations [ 77 ] , or over programs whose nodes invoke a language model [ 99 , 34 , 87 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 神经符号方法将提供语义判断的神经组件与组合其输出的符号层配对。 让组合过程保持显式而不是折叠进网络的权重中，可使判定结果可读、可检验，并能捕捉单次前向传播无法捕捉的程序性结构 [ 10 ] 。 以下内容围绕两个维度展开：符号层的表达能力有多强，以及方法中有多少部分是学习得到的而非预先固定的。 在第一个维度上，符号层从逻辑程序 [ 52 , 49 ] 到可执行代码 [ 22 , 11 , 48 , 29 , 84 , 83 , 14 ] 不等；与规则由人工编写、神经谓词通过其推理进行训练的逻辑程序不同，可执行代码可以由大语言模型编写和修改，并能在中间结果上直接调用模型。 在第二个维度上，组合结构及其调用的神经谓词既可以是给定的，也可以是学习得到的。 经典的可微程序固定结构并通过它训练谓词 [ 52 , 49 , 4 ] ，而其他方法还会搜索结构本身：在类型化函数式语言上搜索 [ 85 ] ，借助神经松弛来引导搜索 [ 77 ] ，或在节点调用语言模型的程序上进行搜索 [ 99 , 34 , 87 ] 。

sents.zh: 在第一个维度上，符号层从逻辑程序 [ 52 , 49 ] 到可执行代码 [ 22 , 11 , 48 , 29 , 84 , 83 , 14 ] 不等；与规则由人工编写、神经谓词通过其推理进行训练的逻辑程序不同，可执行代码可以由大语言模型编写和修改，并能在中间结果上直接调用模型。

sents.en: On the second axis, both the composition and the neural predicates it calls may be either given or learned.
sents.zh: 在第二个维度上，组合结构及其调用的神经谓词既可以是给定的，也可以是学习得到的。

sents.en: Classical differentiable programs fix the structure and train the predicates through it [ 52 , 49 , 4 ] , while others search for the structure as well: over a typed functional language [ 85 ] , guided by neural relaxations [ 77 ] , or over programs whose nodes invoke a language model [ 99 , 34 , 87 ] .
sents.zh: 经典的可微程序固定结构并通过它训练谓词 [ 52 , 49 , 4 ] ，而其他方法还会搜索结构本身：在类型化函数式语言上搜索 [ 85 ] ，借助神经松弛来引导搜索 [ 77 ] ，或在节点调用语言模型的程序上进行搜索 [ 99 , 34 , 87 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods have stayed on one side of each axis at a time. One line derives a symbolic structure, generated from the policy or fit to data, but over a restricted formalism: a count over atomic yes/no questions [ 46 , 15 ] , linear weights over natural-language rules [ 58 , 92 ] , a probabilistic circuit over trajectory predicates [ 12 ] , or a logical encoding checked by an SMT solver [ 3 ] . Such a formalism is tractable to derive precisely because it is restricted, and for the same reason it cannot make which question is asked depend on earlier answers, count occurrences over spans extracted from the input, or repeat a check over parts of the input selected at run time, structures that real policies commonly contain. The other line writes the composition as code, gaining that expressiveness, but leaves the program fixed: hand-authored rails [ 73 ] , a synthesized function verified against self-generated tests and specifications [ 56 , 104 ] , or a program emitted per task whose generator is never tuned against the policy [ 36 , 89 ] . Its predicates are frozen prompts, so one that drifts from the clause it transcribes stays drifted. SCOPE combines both lines: its composition is ordinary Python, and its structure and predicates are optimized jointly against the policy.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法在每条轴上都只停留在其中一端。 一条路线推导符号结构，或由策略生成、或拟合数据得到，但受限于受限的形式体系：对原子化是/否问题的计数 [46, 15]、对自然语言规则的线性加权 [58, 92]、基于轨迹谓词的概率电路 [12]，或由 SMT 求解器检验的逻辑编码 [3]。 这种形式体系之所以能够被精确推导，恰恰是因为它受限；而出于同样的原因，它无法让所提出的问题依赖于先前得到的答案、无法对从输入中提取的片段进行出现次数统计，也无法在运行时选定的输入部分上重复执行某项检查——而这些结构在真实策略中十分常见。 另一条路线将这种组合写成代码，从而获得了这种表达能力，但程序本身是固定的：人工编写的护栏 [73]、经自我生成的测试与规格验证的合成函数 [56, 104]，或针对每个任务生成的程序，而其生成器从未针对策略进行调优 [36, 89]。 其谓词是冻结的提示词，因此某个偏离其所转述条款的提示词会一直保持偏离状态。 SCOPE 将两条路线结合起来：它的组合是普通的 Python 代码，而其结构和谓词则针对该策略进行联合优化。

paragraphs.en: A training pool synthesized once from the task description [ 95 , 44 , 54 ] fixes the distribution before optimization begins. Curriculum learning instead presents examples in a deliberate order, from easy to hard rather than at random [ 9 ] . The order need not be set in advance: self-paced learning selects the next examples by the model’s current competence [ 45 ] , and automated curricula place a teacher in the loop that picks each round’s examples to maximize the student’s learning progress [ 28 , 53 , 69 ] . Across these, the schedule is regenerated as the model improves, so that training mass tracks where the model is currently weak rather than the base rate of the data.
paragraphs.zh: 从任务描述一次性合成得到的训练池 [ 95 , 44 , 54 ] 在优化开始之前就固定了数据分布。 课程学习则改为以精心设计的顺序呈现示例，即从易到难，而非随机呈现 [ 9 ] 。 这一顺序无需预先设定：自我节奏学习根据模型当前的能力来选择接下来的示例 [ 45 ] ，而自动化课程则在回路中引入一个教师，由其挑选每一轮的示例，以最大化学生的学习进展 [ 28 , 53 , 69 ] 。 在这些方法中，训练计划会随着模型的改进而重新生成，从而使训练样本的分布跟随模型当前薄弱之处，而不是数据的基础分布。

paragraphs.en: One such curriculum builds its examples adversarially, generating rather than ranking: instead of drawing from a fixed set, it produces the inputs on which the current model fails [ 47 ] . paragraphs.en: Scope folds this adversarial curriculum into the decomposition search, building the training data and optimizing the program together. Unlike the schemes above, its target is a program with named sub-components, so a counterexample points to the part at fault, and its verifier is a strong model reading the policy rather than a sound solver, which sacrifices formal guarantees for applicability to policies no solver accepts.
paragraphs.zh: Scope 将这种对抗式课程融入分解搜索之中，同时构建训练数据并优化程序。 与上述方案不同，它的目标是一个包含命名子组件的程序，因此反例可以指出出问题的部分；其验证器是读取策略的强模型而非可靠的求解器，这牺牲了形式化保证，换取了对求解器无法接受的策略的适用性。

paragraphs.en: SCOPE searches for an executable program π \pi that reproduces the verdicts of a natural-language policy when every predicate is answered by a weak model. The policy assigns each input, such as a conversation or an agent trace, a label from a fixed set or, for multi-label tasks, a set of labels. As detailed in Section 3.1 , the program consists of predicates , classification questions answered by a weak LLM, and extractors , deterministic functions over the input, combined by Python composition code. We denote by s ⁡ ( π , D ) s(\pi,D) the score of π \pi on a pool D D , measured as accuracy for single-label tasks and the Jaccard index for multi-label tasks. Only a small seed pool D 0 D_{0} of human-labeled samples is given. During optimization, an adversarial process generates new samples that target where the program may depart from the policy and adds them to the pool. The program is thus fit to the policy rather than to a fixed dataset.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 illustrates the optimization process. It starts from a single predicate, the policy itself, and alternates two components. The optimizer executes π \pi on the current training pool D t D_{t} , uses the predicate traces to attribute each failure to a predicate or to the composition code, and revises the program. The adversarial generators then produce samples on which the revised program is likely to disagree with the policy, targeting both individual predicates and the composition as a whole. A teacher applying the full policy labels them to form D t + 1 D_{t+1} . The search stops at a threshold τ \tau or after K K rounds, and returns the program that scores highest on D 0 D_{0} . The search is carried out by strong LLM agents, whose prompts are given in Appendix F . The predicates, by contrast, are part of the program and are answered by a weak model during the search. A program therefore scores well only if a weak model can execute it, matching the target deployment setting.

paragraphs.en: A program consists of predicates, extractors, and composition code. A predicate is a natural-language classification question with a fixed label set, typically binary. An extractor is a deterministic function that returns a value, a span, or a list of spans from the input. The composition code is a Python function that invokes extractors to select spans, applies predicates to them, and maps the resulting labels to a verdict. Predicates do not specify their input; the composition code determines the text to which each predicate is applied. The same predicate may therefore be applied to the full input, to a span within it, or repeatedly within a single sample.
paragraphs.zh: 程序由谓词、抽取器和组合代码组成。 谓词是一个自然语言分类问题，具有固定的标签集合，通常是二元的。 抽取器是一个确定性函数，从输入中返回一个值、一个片段或一个片段列表。 组合代码是一个 Python 函数，它调用抽取器来选择片段，对片段应用谓词，并将得到的标签映射为一个判定结果。 谓词不指定其输入；组合代码决定每个谓词应用于哪段文本。 因此，同一个谓词可以被应用于完整输入、输入中的某个片段，或在单个样本内被多次应用。

paragraphs.en: Expressing the composition as code allows the program to mirror the structure of the policy. A predicate can be restricted to the region its question concerns, such as one section of a long input, or applied multiple times to different parts of the input. Although predicate label sets are fixed, the program can handle tasks whose label set varies per sample or that require multiple labels, by determining how predicates are applied to the sample’s candidates and how their outputs form the final prediction. paragraphs.en: During the search, every predicate call is answered by an executor , a sub-frontier model run with reasoning disabled and instructed to return only the label. The executor is chosen to match the capability of the models intended for deployment. A predicate that the executor cannot answer reliably is likely to be reworded or split into simpler questions. paragraphs.zh: 在搜索过程中，每个谓词调用都由一个执行器（executor）来回答，它是一个关闭推理功能的子前沿模型，被指示只返回标签。 执行器的选择要与目标部署模型的能力相匹配。 执行器无法可靠回答的谓词，很可能会被重新表述或拆分成更简单的问题。 因此，程序的结构会适应执行器的能力，较弱的执行器会产生包含更多谓词的程序（图 3 b）。 由于执行器只接收一个谓词及其输入，而不接收策略，每个谓词都必须是自包含的，需要说明其所编码条款的定义、范围和例外情况。

paragraphs.en: The search starts from the undecomposed task: a single predicate, the policy itself, applied to the full input. Before the first round, the teacher writes a rationale for each seed sample. At round t t , the teacher labels the samples the adversaries added in the previous round (Section 3.3 ), and the current program is executed on D t D_{t} . The analyzer receives the policy, the program, and, for every sample, the predicted verdict, the gold label, its rationale, and the trace. Supervision exists only for the final verdict, so the analyzer infers which calls caused a failure by working backward: it replays the composition code on the recorded predicate labels, finds the labels that would have had to differ to produce the gold verdict, and inspects the text those calls received. Each failure is thus attributed to a predicate whose wording does not encode its clause, or to composition code that misencodes the policy. Correctly classified samples with similar rationales serve as a contrast set for checking candidate fixes against regressions.

paragraphs.en: The analyzer then recommends revisions: rewording or splitting a predicate, adding or removing a predicate or extractor, moving a condition between a predicate and an extractor, or rewriting the composition code. Each recommendation must be grounded in a clause, definition, or exception of the policy. A revision justified only by a phrase observed in a sample would fit the pool rather than the policy, and is excluded. The decomposer treats these recommendations as proposals and weighs them against the search history: previous programs and their scores, the revisions applied in the last round, and revisions already tried from the current program without improvement. When recent rounds do not improve the score, the search backtracks to the best program found so far, and the decomposer must pursue a substantially different direction, which prevents cycling among similar programs. The search terminates when s ⁡ ( π , D t ) s(\pi,D_{t}) reaches a threshold τ \tau , or after K K rounds. Since D t D_{t} grows across rounds, its scores are not comparable between rounds, so the returned program is the candidate with the highest score s ⁡ ( π , D 0 ) s(\pi,D_{0}) on the fixed seed pool.

paragraphs.en: Optimizing against a fixed pool rewards fitting the pool: a policy condition that the pool rarely exercises can be omitted at little cost in accuracy, and the pool provides no signal to restore it. Supervision thus concentrates where the program is wrong, analogously to counterexample-guided synthesis [ 80 ] , with the policy as the specification. Both adversaries see the current pool, including D 0 D_{0} and all previously generated samples, so new samples stay consistent with it and avoid redundancy.

paragraphs.en: The adversaries operate at two levels. The systemic adversary targets global drift: a clause, exception, or interaction between clauses that the program as a whole misrepresents. It reads the full program and generates inputs on which the composition omits or misroutes part of the policy (Appendix E.1 ). The local adversary targets local drift: a single predicate that no longer tracks the clause it encodes. It examines one predicate at a time, together with traces of the inputs that predicate receives, and generates inputs that probe where its wording diverges from the clause (Appendix E.2 ). Each sample is generated with an intended label and a justification. The teacher, applying the full policy, labels it without seeing either, and the sample enters the pool only if the two labels agree, so every admitted sample reflects two separate readings of the policy.

paragraphs.en: Coaching. In an agentic fitness and wellness system, one component generates short coaching messages, and an automated critic judges each message against a seven-dimension rubric. The task audits the critic: given a message with the critic’s verdict and reasoning, output Pass, Fail, or Bug. A classifier must first judge the message itself, then check the critic’s verdict and cited reasons against that judgment. Bug covers a wrong verdict, or a correct rejection with an inapplicable reason (Appendix E.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 教练指导。 在一个智能体化的健身与健康系统中，一个组件生成简短的教练指导消息，而一个自动化评审器（critic）根据七维评分标准对每条消息进行评判。 该任务是对评审器进行审计：给定一条消息以及评审器的判定和理由，输出 Pass、Fail 或 Bug。 分类器必须先对消息本身作出判断，然后据此判断核对评审器的判定及其引用的理由。 Bug 涵盖判定错误的情况，或判定正确（拒绝）但所引用的理由不适用的情况（附录 E.1）。

paragraphs.en: Escalation. Inspired by the counting policies of DynaGuard [ 33 ] , the input is a customer-support dialogue. Escalation is warranted when the user re-raises the same unresolved intent at least three times, verbatim or rephrased. A turn that adds a new constraint, question, or information does not count, so each turn must be compared semantically with the earlier ones. The label is True when the agent’s final reply escalates exactly when warranted (Appendix E.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 升级。 受 DynaGuard [33] 的计数策略启发，输入是一段客户支持对话。 当用户至少三次重复提出同一未解决的意图（无论是原话还是换一种说法）时，应当触发升级。 增加新约束、新问题或新信息的轮次不计入，因此每一轮必须在语义上与之前的轮次进行比较。 当且仅当确有必要时，智能体的最终回复才进行升级，则标签为 True（附录 E.2）。

paragraphs.en: Plan. Built on GAIA [ 55 ] with authored samples, the input is a full agent trace ending in a research plan [ 74 ] . A plan is valid if it references only available tools and collaborators, refers to tools abstractly, and ends with an <end_plan> tag. A plan typically spans a few hundred characters within a trace of tens of thousands.
paragraphs.zh: 计划。 该任务构建于 GAIA [ 55 ] 之上并使用了人工编写的样本，输入是一段完整的智能体轨迹，以一份研究计划 [ 74 ] 结尾。 如果一份计划仅引用可用的工具与协作者、以抽象方式提及工具，并以 <end_plan> 标签结尾，则该计划是有效的。 一份计划通常只有几百个字符，而整条轨迹则长达数万个字符。

paragraphs.en: Tile-match. Given a conversation with a financial-dashboard assistant and the list of tiles on screen, the task identifies the tiles the user’s last message refers to: one, several, or none. Each sample thus defines its own label space, and predictions are scored by the mean Jaccard index. Of the 124 test samples, 55 refer to no tile and serve as hard negatives against plausible distractors.
paragraphs.zh: 瓦片匹配。 给定一段与财务仪表盘助手的对话以及屏幕上的瓦片列表，该任务是识别用户最后一条消息所指的瓦片：一个、多个或没有。 因此，每个样本都定义了自己的标签空间，预测结果以平均 Jaccard 指数评分。 在 124 个测试样本中，有 55 个不指向任何瓦片，它们作为困难负样本，用于对抗看似合理的干扰项。

paragraphs.en: Prompt optimization. To separate the effect of structural decomposition from prompt optimization alone, we compare against two optimizers implemented in DSPy [ 40 , 39 ] : GEPA [ 1 ] and MIPROv2 [ 65 ] . Both improve a fixed task description by rewriting it (MIPROv2 also selects few-shot demonstrations), without decomposing the task. GEPA maintains a pool of candidate instructions. It reflects on execution traces and metric feedback on a minibatch of training instances to propose a revision, and selects the next candidate to mutate from the Pareto front over training instances. MIPROv2 is a Bayesian optimizer that jointly searches over instructions and bootstrapped few-shot demonstrations, using a proposal model to draft candidate instructions grounded in a summary of the training data. For a controlled comparison, both optimize on the training pool that SCOPE starts from, use the same executor model, and are scored on the same held-out test set.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词优化。 为了将结构化分解的效果与单纯的提示词优化区分开，我们在 DSPy [40, 39] 中实现的两个优化器上进行了比较：GEPA [1] 和 MIPROv2 [65]。 二者都通过重写固定的任务描述来改进它（MIPROv2 还会选择少样本示例），而不对任务进行分解。 GEPA 维护一个候选指令池。 它基于一批训练实例反思执行轨迹和指标反馈以提出修订，并从训练实例上的帕累托前沿中选择下一个待变异的候选。 MIPROv2 是一种贝叶斯优化器，联合搜索指令和自举的少样本示例，并使用一个提议模型基于训练数据的摘要起草候选指令。 为了进行受控比较，二者都在 SCOPE 起始的训练池上进行优化，使用相同的执行器模型，并在相同的留出测试集上进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Task decomposition. We evaluate Scope with three executor models: gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5.4-mini [ 63 ] , and gemini-3.5-flash [ 27 ] , each configured with reasoning disabled. We compare against two neurosymbolic task-decomposition baselines. CheckEval [ 46 ] is a checklist-based LLM-as-a-judge that decomposes the policy into binary yes/no questions seeded from a manual list and expanded through LLM diversification and elaboration, and scores each sample by the proportion of “yes” answers. RLIE [ 92 ] instead induces a set of natural-language rules from labeled samples, refined iteratively and combined by a logistic regression. By construction, both methods support only binary labels, so we evaluate them only on the binary tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 任务分解。 我们使用三个执行模型评估 Scope：gpt-5.4-nano、gpt-5.4-mini [ 63 ] 以及 gemini-3.5-flash [ 27 ]，每个模型均配置为关闭推理。 我们与两个神经符号式任务分解基线进行比较。 CheckEval [ 46 ] 是一种基于清单的 LLM 即评委方法，它将策略分解为二元的“是/否”问题——这些问题以人工列表为种子，并通过 LLM 的多样化和细化进行扩展——并按每个样本中“是”答案的比例打分。 RLIE [ 92 ] 则从有标注样本中归纳出一组自然语言规则，经迭代优化后由逻辑回归进行组合。 从构造上看，这两种方法仅支持二元标签，因此我们只在二元任务上对它们进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Automated workflow generation. We compare against AFlow [ 99 ] , an automated agentic-workflow optimizer, which runs Monte-Carlo tree search over programs that orchestrate multiple LLM calls through reusable operators. Like Scope it searches over executable programs rather than a single prompt, but its search space is open-ended rather than a decomposition of the policy. Since Scope and all other baselines were allowed to emit nothing but the label, we restricted AFlow to the Custom operator and disabled chain-of-thought answer generation. Notably, the instructions AFlow writes for the Custom operator may themselves elicit intermediate reasoning, on which the final label can be conditioned. This is inherent to the method, so we left it in place, thus allowing AFlow a capability that the other methods did not have.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化工作流生成。 我们与 AFlow [99] 进行比较，这是一种自动化的智能体工作流优化器，它通过可复用的算子对编排多次 LLM 调用的程序运行蒙特卡洛树搜索。 与 Scope 类似，它搜索的是可执行程序而非单个提示词，但其搜索空间是开放式的，而不是对策略的分解。 由于 Scope 和所有其他基线都只被允许输出标签本身，我们限制 AFlow 只能使用 Custom 算子，并禁用了思维链式的答案生成。 值得注意的是，AFlow 为 Custom 算子编写的指令本身可能会引出中间推理，而最终标签可以基于这些中间推理得出。 这是该方法固有的特性，因此我们将其保留，从而允许 AFlow 拥有其他方法所不具备的能力。

paragraphs.en: All core models in the decomposition process (the analyzer, decomposer, adversarial sample generators and teacher) run Claude Opus 4.8 [ 6 ] in an agentic loop. The agent SDK [ 5 ] provides file access, allowing the models to (i) read long records from disk on demand rather than receiving them inline, keeping prompts compact for tasks with inputs spanning tens of thousands of characters, and (ii) generate very long samples by editing seeds, which is difficult to accomplish in standard inference mode. The executor models run the predicates, producing only a label, without a rationale.
paragraphs.zh: 分解过程中的所有核心模型（分析器、分解器、对抗样本生成器和教师模型）都在一个智能体循环中运行 Claude Opus 4.8 [ 6 ]。 智能体 SDK [ 5 ] 提供文件访问能力，使模型能够：(i) 按需从磁盘读取长记录而不是将其内联接收，从而在输入长达数万字符的任务中保持提示词的紧凑性；(ii) 通过编辑种子来生成非常长的样本，这在标准推理模式下难以实现。 执行器模型运行谓词，仅输出一个标签，不给出理由。

paragraphs.en: For each task, we split the human-annotated set into training and test portions. The training portion forms the initial pool D 0 D_{0} . The test portion is used only for the final evaluation. The search runs for at most K = 8 K=8 iterations, and stops early once accuracy on the current training pool reaches τ = 0.98 \tau=0.98 . In each iteration, the systemic adversary generates at most three samples and each predicate-local adversary adds at most one, so that adversarial samples enrich the human-labeled pool without dominating it.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们将人工标注集合划分为训练部分和测试部分。 训练部分构成初始池 D 0 D_{0}。 测试部分仅用于最终评估。 搜索最多运行 K = 8 K=8 次迭代，一旦当前训练池上的准确率达到 τ = 0.98 \tau=0.98，即提前停止。 在每次迭代中，系统性对抗者最多生成三个样本，而每个谓词局部对抗者最多添加一个，从而使对抗样本在丰富人工标注池的同时不会占据主导地位。

paragraphs.en: Beyond accuracy and cost, decomposition provides a degree of stability and explainability that is absent from the monolithic high-end models. We evaluated prediction stability by running each model five times on the Tile-match dataset, whose multi-label structure requires multiple independent decisions per sample, making it particularly challenging from a stability perspective. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3-235B-A22B were substantially more stable: only 5–7% of samples changed their prediction at least once across the five runs, compared with 37% for gpt-5.5 and 26% for gemini-3.1-pro. As each prediction is traceable to a set of explicit predicates, this stability yields a more explainable and interpretable decision process than the opaque predictions of the monolithic models.
paragraphs.zh: 除准确率和成本之外，任务分解还提供了单体高端模型所缺乏的一定程度的稳定性与可解释性。 我们通过让每个模型在 Tile-match 数据集上运行五次来评估预测稳定性；该数据集的多标签结构要求对每个样本做出多个独立决策，因此从稳定性的角度看尤其具有挑战性。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B 的稳定性明显更高：在五次运行中仅有 5–7% 的样本至少出现过一次预测变化，而 gpt-5.5 为 37%，gemini-3.1-pro 为 26%。 由于每个预测都可以追溯到一组明确的谓词，这种稳定性使得决策过程比单体模型不透明的预测更具可解释性与可理解性。

paragraphs.en: To achieve sufficient independent measurements for assessing statistical significance, for each setting we ran five independent optimization runs (for the Full variant, these include the three runs of Table 2 ), and averaged three test evaluations per run output. paragraphs.en: We presented Scope , which treats a natural-language policy as a specification to compile rather than a prompt to interpret, turning it into a program of neural predicates, deterministic extractors, and composition code. The program is optimized jointly with an adversarially grown training pool. Running the predicates with a weak executor steers the search toward predicates within its reach. Across four policy-enforcement tasks, Scope achieves the highest accuracy in most settings, with the largest gains under the weakest executor, and finds decompositions that are far less sensitive to the choice of executor. Programs transfer to other executors without further optimization. When run by non-reasoning open-weight models, they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models, at a fraction of the cost, while producing substantially more stable verdicts, each traceable to the predicate outputs behind it. Because the program is checked against a strong teacher rather than a formal verifier, its correctness rests on the teacher’s reading of the policy, and verifying such programs remains an open problem. The underlying optimization, which co-evolves a program with the counterexamples that challenge it, is not specific to policy enforcement and may carry over to other tasks specified in natural language, such as rubric-based LLM evaluation and reward modeling. We release our benchmark to support further research on compound policy enforcement.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows a possible decomposition of the Coaching task (Appendix E.1 ), obtained using gpt-5.4-nano as the executor. The input has four fields: the coaching message, the system state, and the evaluator’s verdict and reasoning. The program consists of two phases. First, it determines whether the coaching message contains any violations, using five predicates for the dimensions that require semantic judgment and two deterministic functions that verify the word-count and sentence-count rubrics. The result is stored in detected_violations . In the second phase, it compares this result with the evaluator’s verdict and reasoning, verifying that either both are clean or that every violation cited by the evaluator is supported by a detected violation. This comparison uses two predicates that audit the evaluator’s evidence, operating on the message and each piece of evidence independently. The resulting decision tree terminates in one of three outcomes: Pass , Fail , or Bug .

paragraphs.en: The Escalation dataset is based on the DynaGuard benchmark [ 33 ] , which contains multi-turn dialogues annotated against custom policies. In the original policy, the agent escalates by returning a fixed string once repetition is detected. We generalized the definition of escalation to any reply connecting the user with a human agent, sharpened the notion of intent-based repetition, and extended the dataset with additional challenging human-annotated samples. The training and test splits contain 85 and 286 samples. The test samples are divided into 147 True and 139 False. The True samples comprise 74 with three or more repeated intents followed by escalation and 73 with fewer than three repeated intents and no escalation. The False samples comprise 69 with three or more repeated intents but no escalation and 70 with escalation but fewer than three repeated intents.
paragraphs.zh: Escalation 数据集基于 DynaGuard 基准 [33]，其中包含按自定义策略标注的多轮对话。 在原策略中，智能体在检测到重复后通过返回固定字符串来进行升级（escalation）。 我们将升级的定义泛化为任何将用户与人工客服连接起来的回复，强化了基于意图的重复这一概念，并通过额外具有挑战性的人工标注样本扩展了数据集。 训练集和测试集分别包含 85 个和 286 个样本。 测试样本分为 147 个 True 和 139 个 False。 True 样本包含 74 个具有三次及以上重复意图且随后发生升级的样本，以及 73 个重复意图少于三次且未发生升级的样本。 False 样本包含 69 个具有三次及以上重复意图但未发生升级的样本，以及 70 个发生升级但重复意图少于三次的样本。

paragraphs.en: The Plan dataset is built on traces of a research agent solving tasks from the GAIA benchmark [ 55 ] . Each trace is labeled Pass or Fail, according to whether the agent’s plan is valid. In the original dataset, invalid plans fail in a single way, by omitting the <end_plan> tag. We added authored samples that violate the other two conditions as well, referring to tools or collaborators absent from the trace and specifying explicit tool calls, as well as boundary valid samples that challenge each of the conditions. The training and test splits contain 82 and 81 samples, the latter divided into 41 Fail and 40 Pass.
paragraphs.zh: Plan 数据集基于一个研究型智能体解决 GAIA 基准 [55] 中任务的轨迹构建。 每条轨迹根据智能体的计划是否有效被标注为 Pass 或 Fail。 在原始数据集中，无效计划仅以一种方式失败，即遗漏 <end_plan> 标签。 我们还添加了人工编写的样本，这些样本同样违反另外两个条件——引用轨迹中不存在的工具或协作者，以及指定显式的工具调用——同时也添加了针对每个条件的边界有效样本。 训练集和测试集分别包含 82 和 81 个样本，后者分为 41 个 Fail 和 40 个 Pass。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 compares the inference cost of the two configurations studied in Section 5.1 : a decomposition run by an inexpensive executor and a frontier reasoning model applied to the undecomposed task. For the decomposition, we assume pricing of $0.15 per 1M input tokens, comparable to the list price of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; since decomposition runs without reasoning, we treat its output cost as negligible. We compare to gemini-3.1-pro with dynamic thinking, the cheaper of the two frontier models by list price ($2 and $12 per 1M input and output tokens vs. $5 and $30 for gpt-5.5). Although the decomposition makes several predicate calls per sample, it costs 9 to 47 times less.
paragraphs.zh: 表5比较了第5.1节所研究的两种配置的推理成本：由廉价的执行器运行的分解，以及应用于未分解任务的前沿推理模型。 对于分解，我们假设定价为每100万输入token 0.15美元，与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的标价相当；由于分解在运行时不进行推理，我们将其输出成本视为可忽略不计。 我们与启用动态思考的gemini-3.1-pro进行比较，按标价它是两个前沿模型中较便宜的一个（每100万输入和输出token分别为2美元和12美元，而gpt-5.5为5美元和30美元）。 尽管分解在每个样本中进行多次谓词调用，但其成本降低了9至47倍。

paragraphs.en: We present two adversarial examples, one from each level of the adversary: a systemic sample, which exposes a gap in how the composition program combines predicates, and a local sample, which exposes a single predicate misjudging an input within its own scope. Both examples target intermediate decompositions produced during the search.
